title: Core internal moves, part 2: diagnostics, directories, Laravel, sources, storage and testing zones
summary: Mechanical relocation of the core internal types of Diagnostics, Directories, Laravel, Sources, Storage and Testing into `<Zone>\Internal\` exactly as the oracle rows say (≈93 rows, e.g. `Diagnostics\Checks\*` → `Diagnostics\Internal\Checks\*`, `Laravel\Console\Commands\*` → `Laravel\Internal\Console\Commands\*`, `Storage\Storage` → `Storage\Internal\Storage` (close+move), `Directories\ModelSubjectDirectory`/`ModelTenantDirectory` (close+move)); references, docblocks, string FQCNs, `__DIR__` paths, allowlist paths and pinned snapshots follow. No behavior change.
why: D13: implementation lives under `<Zone>\Internal\` so boundaries are visible in the namespace and the I2–I4 scans stay mechanical; P3 moves each internal type once. Hard risk: a missed string FQCN (config, JSON fixture, phpstan ignore, stub, docs) or a stale `__DIR__` path breaks only at runtime — the sweep in #moves and the full suite catch it.

include: Rows with action `move` or `close+move` and phase `P3` whose current FQCN is in Diagnostics, Directories, Laravel, Sources, Storage and Testing (knowledge/type-map #zone-diagnostics, #zone-directories, #zone-laravel, #zone-sources, #zone-storage, #zone-testing)
close+move rows lose their `#[Api]`/`#[Spi]` attribute; nothing supported may reference them afterwards (I4)

`StorageMigrationCommand` stub path and `AzGuardServiceProvider` paths (`config`, `database`, `resources`) recomputed after the move; `Laravel\Internal\Console\GrantCommandSupport` stays where P2 put it
Pinned snapshots that name moved classes regenerated in writer mode (list them in the result)

Migration lines for the close+move rows: `Directories\ModelSubjectDirectory`/`ModelTenantDirectory` → depend on `Contracts\Subjects\SubjectDirectory`/`Contracts\Tenancy\TenantDirectory`; `Storage\Storage` → `Storage\StorageDescriptor`
